cases.task: Make AsyncBatchNode and AsyncParallelBatchNode treat prep_async returning None as an empty batch, consistent with BatchNode and the default prep method. Their public run_async lifecycle must call post_async with an empty result and must not call exec_async for None or empty iterables. Preserve nonempty sequence/generator order and exception propagation. Add regression tests in tests/test_async_empty_prep.py and run the repository tests.

Preserve existing ASCII punctuation/whitespace behavior, Unicode letters, combining marks and Unicode non-punctuation symbols. This is an explicit feature extension. Add regression tests to tests/test_strutils.py and run that file.
